description: A refusal that COMPILES is raised over a table with no rows: unknown functions (bare, in a view, in a CTAS), the full 32-pair temporal +/- operand matrix (only d-d, d+n, d-n, n+d, ts-ts, n+n, n-n are legal - NUMBER + DATE accepted while NUMBER - DATE refused), mixed binary concatenation, and all three timestamp flavours (all nine flavour pairs subtract legally and add illegally, the refusal naming the given flavour with its precision). Value-coercion failures (division by zero, unparseable dates, non-numeric strings in numeric functions) stay runtime and pass over no rows, as do specially-resolved names (windows, aggregates, higher-order lambdas, SYSTEM$) and catalog UDFs. Converted 1:1 from expressions/CompileTimeRefusalTest (now retired).
